assumptions.choice: Ignored the spec's $100,000 starting capital; used whatever cash the harness's cerebro provides ($10,000) since broker cash is fixed by the harness, not the strategy class.
assumptions.reason: Execution environment states starting cash and cerebro setup are fixed by the harness and outside the strategy's control.

assumptions.choice: Ignored the spec's 2015-01-01 to 2017-12-31 QQQ window; ran over whatever data the harness feeds (QQQ 2020-01-02 to 2025-12-30).
assumptions.reason: The harness supplies a single fixed data feed; the strategy class cannot select a different date range or re-fetch data.

assumptions.choice: On entry, buy size = int(available cash / current close price), i.e. spend the maximum whole shares affordable with all available cash ('100% of available capital per trade').
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly states 100% of capital per trade, so the canonical no-size-argument default does not apply; no sizer object is available since cerebro is configured by the harness, so sizing is computed manually in next().

assumptions.choice: Interpreted 'the first time %K > 85 is met' as the standard crossing event (prev %K <= 85 and current %K > 85), re-armed after each exit so multiple trades can occur over the backtest.
assumptions.reason: The report requirement 'number of trades' implies more than a single one-shot lifetime entry; the phrase is read as defining what a 'cross above' means, not restricting the strategy to one trade total.

assumptions.choice: Did not add slippage configuration; relied solely on the harness's fixed 0.001 commission.
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'include slippage if available' but gives no slippage model/parameters, and cerebro/broker configuration is added by the harness, not the strategy class, so no slippage setting is invented.

assumptions.choice: Did not compute or emit total/annual return, max drawdown, Sharpe ratio, or trade count from within the strategy.
assumptions.reason: These are backtest-level reporting metrics normally produced by cerebro analyzers configured by the harness; the strategy class only encodes entry/exit trading logic per the environment's single-class output constraint.

assumptions.choice: When the 260-bar high equals the 260-bar low (denominator 0), set %K = 0.0 for that bar instead of raising a division error.
assumptions.reason: Spec is silent on this degenerate case; treating it as %K=0 keeps the strategy from erroring while not triggering a spurious entry (0 is far below the 85 entry threshold).
